t: This is Prince Arthur Road, a street in Hampstead, in the London Borough of Camden. It takes its name from Prince Arthur, Duke of Connaught and Strathearn, the seventh child and third son of Queen Victoria and Prince Albert. Later in life he served as Governor General of Canada, from 1911 to 1916, and he remains the only British prince ever to hold that post. So as you walk along, you're passing a name that links this quiet corner of north London to the royal family and to Canada.
